- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kentucky Innovation Network offers business resources, mentoring, and access to capital for entrepreneurs and startups.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] These programs aim to attract new businesses, encourage expansion, and create jobs for Kentuckians.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kentucky Work Ready initiative aims to provide a highly skilled, job-ready workforce by connecting workers with necessary training and education.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kentucky Angel Investment Tax Credit, passed in early 2021, encourages investment in early-stage startups and businesses in Kentucky.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kentucky AgriTech Initiative promotes innovation and growth in the agriculture sector by supporting agtech startups and traditional farming businesses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kentucky Broadband Initiative aims to expand high-speed internet access to rural and underserved areas to attract business investment and growth.
